summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py (stdlib only) covering all eight depot formats and the shared export conventions (gzip, BOM/charset, mid-file directives and headers, row-level units, timestamps with offsets, layout switching), ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/summary.json, and check_summary.py reports every value matches. Behaviour on other exports is untested beyond following the documented rules.
